title: Quarantine Was Born Here
sentences: The word quarantine comes from the Italian for forty days.
But the first rule was thirty.
In 1377, the city of Ragusa, today's Dubrovnik, made arriving ships wait thirty days.
Venice later stretched it to forty.
We still use the idea today.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
